Context.normalized_text: MainActivity observes `goViewModel.getRequestAuth()` and, when the observed Boolean is true, logs the request, resets it to false, and performs an authentication-related action.
`GoViewModel` stores the authentication-request signal in a `MutableLiveData<Boolean>`, exposes it through `getRequestAuth()`, and updates it asynchronously with `postValue`.
The user characterizes the Boolean LiveData/reset pattern as a hack used to trigger a callback when authentication is requested.
